inspiration: Arena hazard telegraphs: a data list of ring effects (MeteorMaze_LvL 1.asset, line 15) draws the whole hazard pattern. Recreate as a telegraph layer driven by a list of floor markers, with a maze or spiral shape of our own.

Three-beat ground slam boss: the boss slam is split into a slam, an arrival impact and a shockwave record (Settings/Balance/Spells/Boss/, file names only). Recreate as three chained data records so each beat can be tuned and read separately.

Freeze as a persistent state, not a one-shot effect: Rendering/Spell Visuals has separate Frost Nova State, Ice Block and Ice Barrier folders. Recreate as a held overlay that stays on the unit while the status lasts.

Model-swap status: a target turns into a harmless critter for a short time (Rendering/Characters/Sheep, Settings/Balance/Spells/Polymorph Spell.asset). Recreate as a short model-swap status with our own critter and tint.
Phase-tagged boss callouts: Audio/Characters/Sirus has files named by phase, so each phase change has its own voice cue. Recreate as a phase-change audio cue with our own lines, never copies.
Class as a data record: a class-info asset holds a list of spell references and a power type (Class Info - Mage.asset line 13 onward). Recreate the pattern with our own class names and spell list.

briefs.label: ring-telegraph hazard maze (own label)
briefs.why: Readable at 375 wide: floor rings and a safe lane form one silhouette; one signature behaviour (timed impacts open a lane); one signature sound (a low warning tick). Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance.
briefs.keep: data list of floor markers that the designer edits; impacts timed in beats
briefs.change: a spiral or hex-grid shape, different telegraph colour, our own impact sound. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: three-beat ground slam (own label)
briefs.why: Readable silhouette at 375 wide: a rising windup, a single arrival hit, then an expanding ring. One signature behaviour: the ring expands from the impact point. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance.
briefs.keep: three chained beats as separate data records, so each can be tuned
briefs.change: a different beat count or timing, a ground crack instead of a ring, our own impact sound. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy
briefs.ref: Assets/Settings/Balance/Spells/Boss/Ragnaros Slam Spell.asset; Ragnaros Slam Shockwave Arrival Spell.asset; Ragnaros Slam Shockwave Spell.asset (file names only)

briefs.label: held frost overlay state (own label)
briefs.why: A persistent state visual reads at a glance: the unit is held and its outline changes. One signature effect: a frost rim on the silhouette. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance.
briefs.keep: a separate state overlay that lasts while the status lasts, not a one-shot burst
briefs.change: crystal shards instead of a frost rim, a different tint, a shorter lifetime. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy
briefs.ref: Assets/Rendering/Spell Visuals/Frost Nova State/ and Assets/Rendering/Spell Visuals/Ice Block/ (folder names; not opened)

briefs.label: model-swap critter status (own label)
briefs.why: Comic and readable: a foe becomes a harmless critter for a few seconds. One signature behaviour: the target walks like a critter. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance.
briefs.keep: a short model-swap status that disables the foe's attacks
briefs.change: a different critter, a tinted coat instead of a fleece, a different duration rule. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: phase-change boss callout (own label)
briefs.why: A voice cue at each phase change gives a readable beat at 375 wide and needs no HUD space. One signature sound: a short low callout on each phase. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance.
briefs.keep: one callout per boss phase, tied to the phase number
briefs.change: our own lines and voice, a different phase count, a sting before the callout. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy
briefs.ref: Assets/Audio/Characters/Sirus/ (Sirus_Phase1.ogg, Sirus_Phase2.ogg, Sirus_Phase3.ogg; file names only, not opened)
